The '''''Eliminator''''' was a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] in service to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One notable battle in participated in was the [[Battle of Daalang]] where it carried out an orbital bombardment of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] base.
